svg.title: Transit-amplifying
svg.desc: Packed crypt epithelial progenitor in mitosis with condensed chromosomes, spindle poles, and a beginning cleavage furrow. Biological basis: Transit-amplifying cells divide rapidly above the crypt stem-cell zone before differentiating along absorptive or secretory lineages.
